title: Biological Activities and Technological Uses of Crataegus monogyna Jacq., Sorbus aria (L.) Crantz and Prunus spinosa L. as Functional Ingredients for the Food Industry: A Review
content: This review evaluates the scientific evidence surrounding the chemical composition, biological activities, and potential applications of these fruits in the Mediterranean Diet, which is known for its health-promoting properties. This highlights their dual role as functional food ingredients and dietary supplements, emphasizing their potential for inclusion in modern diets. Although in vitro studies have demonstrated promising bioactivities for all three fruits, in vivo and human studies remain limited, underscoring the need for further research. By bridging traditional knowledge with contemporary applications, this work aims to encourage the integration of these wild fruits into the food and pharmaceutical industries to improve health outcomes.
